observed_state.fixture_note: active_slot='a' is an OFFLINE TEST FIXTURE, not current device evidence. It exists only to exercise the simulation. It MUST NOT be used to decide device-readiness or which slot is safe to write. The tool refuses to treat it as the running slot.

last_confirmed_running.source: operator-reported observation (2026-10-28); prior logs also show slot b as the last successful slot (CLAUDE.md L31)
last_confirmed_running.note: This is the last CONFIRMED running system. It is still NOT a fresh live reading at plan time. A real plan requires freshly re-read slot/unlock state (pass --fresh-active-slot with a source), not this record alone.

observed_state.unlock: LK-only via a PATCHED lk on slot b; does NOT extend into userspace fastbootd. See protected_backups.lk_unlock_caveat: the patched-unlock lk is NOT among the stored backups.

install_target.rationale: Install to the inactive slot b, which carries the unlock-preserving patched lk. Never touch active slot a until the new slot boots.

physical.name: lk
physical.protect_reason: Holds the LK-only unlock on slot b. Lineage OTA excludes lk (verification.json included=false). Writing it would re-lock the device.

physical.name: preloader
physical.protect_reason: preloader_raw excluded by Lineage OTA (verification.json included=false). Preserve both copies; a bad preloader hard-bricks below BROM recovery guarantees.

super.name: super
super.shared_note: There is ONE physical super partition shared by both slots. main_a and main_b are logical groups INSIDE it, not separate physical partitions. A raw rewrite of super replaces the entire physical partition, so it rewrites the other slot's logical group too.
super.raw_rewrite_evidence: CLAUDE.md L328: the rebuilt super is slot-b-only ('overwrites super; stock-A OS can't be preserved in-super; restore via stock super rollback ROM'). No evidence the rebuilt image carries the running slot's logical group, so a raw-super rewrite is NOT proven to preserve the running slot.
super.evidence: CLAUDE.md L328 (single raw 7.0GiB VAB, metadata-slots 3, groups main_a/main_b)

protected_backups.description: These offline backups must exist and match before any plan is accepted. The tool never writes to them.
protected_backups.lk_unlock_caveat: These lk backups are the ORIGINAL STOCK LK dumps captured via BROM on 2026-10-11. They do NOT include the PATCHED lk that provides the LK-only unlock on slot b. Verifying these confirms we can restore stock LK (anti-brick), but it does NOT establish that the patched-unlock lk is backed up or preserved. If slot b's patched lk is lost, the current unlock is lost (and must be re-derived). The patched lk images live outside this backup set and are not verified here.

entries.content: stock lk dump (slot b) — NOT the patched-unlock lk
